name: palaz-mcp-server

tools.name: palaz_list_clients
tools.description: List all clients (brands) accessible with this API key. Returns client IDs, names, category, currency, connected platforms, and KPI/budget targets (monthly_budget, target_roas, target_cpa, sales_cycle_days). Call this first to get client_id values.

tools.name: palaz_account_overview
tools.description: Account vital signs for a client: total spend, conversions, CPA, CTR, platform-reported ROAS vs Shopify-backend ROAS (blended, account-level), a per-platform breakdown, budget pacing (if targets set), and a prior-period comparison. full_access keys also get the account funnel and a syncing_from block (which ad account and pixel the data came from).

tools.name: palaz_campaign_performance
tools.description: Campaign-level performance: spend, conversions, CPA, platform ROAS, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPM, reach, frequency, and a prior-period comparison per campaign; full_access keys also get the per-campaign funnel. Click/view ROAS and learning phase are not available.

tools.name: palaz_creative_performance
tools.description: Ad-level creative performance: spend, spend_share, CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, frequency, format, days_active, plus portfolio metrics (spend-weighted creative age, format mix, spend concentration). Hook/hold/completion rates and landing-page CVR are not available.

tools.name: palaz_daily_spend
tools.description: Daily spend and performance per platform (spend, conversions, CPA, ROAS, impressions, clicks) for pacing and trend/anomaly reads: separates one-day noise from a 3+ day signal.

tools.name: palaz_customer_type_breakdown
tools.description: Account-level new vs returning customer counts for the period. New = first acquired in the window (reliable). Returning is an approximation; per-campaign new/returning is not available. Read the _meta caveats.

tools.name: palaz_funnel_performance
tools.description: Site funnel from Shopify sessions (sessions, cart adds, checkouts, orders, conversion rate) with per-channel traffic quality, against a fixed four-week baseline. Use for a full-funnel read before blaming the ads. (Requires a full_access API key.)

tools.name: palaz_revenue_summary
tools.description: Blended revenue for the period and the period before: gross and net revenue, refunds, total ad spend, MER, contribution margin and profit ROAS from the brand's COGS rate. (Requires a full_access API key.)

tools.name: palaz_attribution_comparison
tools.description: Three-tier attribution check: platform-reported revenue vs channel-attributed Shopify revenue vs blended store revenue, per platform. Use to see how far the platforms over-claim. (Requires a full_access API key.)

tools.name: palaz_pixel_health
tools.description: Meta pixel health proxy: the active pixel, last fired time, first-party cookie status, and warnings (stale or duplicate pixels). Event Match Quality itself is not exposed by Meta at this scope. (Requires a full_access API key.)

tools.name: palaz_conversion_lag
tools.description: Google Ads conversion lag for the account: how long after the click conversions land, so the most recent days are judged with the right discount. (Requires a full_access API key.)

tools.name: palaz_search_terms
tools.description: Google Ads search terms for the period: spend, clicks, conversions and CPA per term, with brand vs non-brand split and wasted-spend candidates. (Requires a full_access API key.)

tools.name: palaz_platform_health
tools.description: Per-platform triage over the last 30 days: data freshness, latest data date, tracking status and known issues per connected platform, so a reader knows whether the numbers can be trusted. (Requires a full_access API key.)

tools.name: palaz_amazon_metrics
tools.description: Amazon Ads account metrics for the period (spend, sales, ACOS, impressions, clicks). A scaffold until a real Amazon Ads account is connected; check _meta. (Requires a full_access API key.)

tools.name: palaz_amazon_keywords
tools.description: Amazon Ads keyword performance for the period. Scaffold; check _meta. (Requires a full_access API key.)

tools.name: palaz_ai_search_traffic
tools.description: AI search referral traffic from GA4 (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini and others): sessions, conversions, revenue, a side-by-side with paid channels, month-over-month trend with a materiality projection, and alerts. Zeros until GA4 is connected (check _meta.ga4_property_id).

tools.name: palaz_subscription_overview
tools.description: Subscription overview for the period vs the period before: active subscriber balance, MRR and ARR, new subscriptions, cancellations and net adds, with a daily series.

tools.name: palaz_subscription_churn
tools.description: Subscription churn for the period: churn rate vs the period before and cancellations by reason.

tools.name: palaz_subscription_revenue
tools.description: Subscription revenue: MRR and ARR, average order value, observed lifetime value, by plan and by acquisition channel.

tools.name: palaz_subscription_acquisition
tools.description: New subscribers by acquisition channel for the period, with the paid CPA per subscriber where the channel is an ad platform.

tools.name: palaz_subscription_economics
tools.description: Subscription unit economics for the period: acquisition cost against subscription value.

tools.name: palaz_subscription_cohorts
tools.description: Subscriber retention curve by signup month: the share of each cohort still active after 1, 2, 3 ... months.

max_months.description: How many signup months back, 1 to 36.

tools.name: palaz_audience_segments
tools.description: RFM segments across all buyers: Elite, Loyalist, Milestone, New Love, Developing, Window Shopper, At-Risk / Dormant, each with its customer count and value.

tools.name: palaz_subscriber_segments
tools.description: The same RFM segments applied to subscribers only, so the retention team sees which segment its subscribers sit in.

tools.name: palaz_segment_customers
tools.description: The customers inside one segment, paged: name, email, orders, spend, last order, acquisition channel. Filter by search text, subscribers only, or the ad source that acquired them.

segment.description: Segment name as returned by palaz_audience_segments.

tools.name: palaz_audience_overview
tools.description: The customer base as of the end of the period and as of the end of the period before: base size, active (ordered within 120 days), at risk, lapsed, repeat buyers, new customers in the period; a 12-month balance by month; new vs returning orders and revenue by day or week; and acquisition channels with repeat rate and LTV per customer.

tools.name: palaz_audience_retention
tools.description: Retention from the order history up to the end of the period: the purchase-to-repurchase funnel (base, second order, 3+ orders, subscribed), second-order rate by first-order month within 60, 90 and 180 days, the first-to-second gap distribution, the median reorder cycle, and the customers now past their own reorder cycle without an order (the list to email).

tools.name: palaz_audience_geography
tools.description: Orders, revenue and customers by state and by city for the period, with each state's share and the brand's top markets.

tools.name: palaz_order_mix
tools.description: Orders by attributed channel for the period (Shopify direct, Meta, Google, TikTok, email, creators, Amazon and others) with revenue and the new vs returning split per channel.

tools.name: palaz_new_customer_value
tools.description: Value per new customer acquired in the period, against the period before: first-order value, follow-on value to date, and the shared CAC definition's denominator.

tools.name: palaz_cohort_value
tools.description: Value per customer as each monthly acquisition cohort ages (month 0, 1, 2 ...), by acquisition channel. The payback read for CAC.

tools.name: palaz_product_launches
tools.description: Product launches detected from first sales in the order items: each product's first-sold date with orders, paid orders and revenue in its first fortnight, plus the brand's ordinary fortnight for scale. Defaults to the last 24 months.

since.description: Only launches on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: palaz_email_performance
tools.description: Klaviyo engagement for the period: messages sent, recipients, opens, clicks, unsubscribes, bounces and their rates, per campaign and flow. Engagement only; revenue comes from palaz_email_orders.

tools.name: palaz_email_orders
tools.description: Orders matched to Klaviyo campaigns and flows for the period: totals, per-message orders and revenue, and the new vs returning split. The revenue side of email.

tools.name: palaz_creators
tools.description: Every creator code and link the order stream saw in the period, who is behind it, and what it cost: orders, revenue, new customers, commission, fees, paid posts, gifting, with each creator's programs and status (tagged, untagged, promo).

tools.name: palaz_creator_content
tools.description: Posts creators published about the brand in the period across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Substack: handle, date, caption, engagement, whether it tagged or named the brand, the creator it files under, and paid or gifted flags.

tools.name: palaz_creative_reads
tools.description: The weekly creative read on each ad on Meta, Google (search ads, display, video, Performance Max asset groups) and TikTok: what the creative shows and says, its verdict and label, its platform, delivery status and the numbers behind it. Covers ads active within the period.

tools.name: palaz_creative_brief
tools.description: The current creative brief per platform (one each for Meta, Google and TikTok, as an array): what wins, what loses, three concepts for the next pieces, and budget moves, from the latest creative reads on that platform.

tools.name: palaz_organic_posts
tools.description: The brand's own Instagram and TikTok posts in the period with likes, comments, and reach, saves and shares where insights are available.

tools.name: palaz_instagram_account
tools.description: The connected Instagram account: followers, media count, 30-day reach, profile views and accounts engaged, the daily reach series, and the last 30 days of posts with their insights.
